item.title: A look back: LANPAR, the first spreadsheet
item.description:
📝 But one spreadsheet you've never heard of is LANPAR, the very first spreadsheet. December 16, 2025Many people think of VisiCalc as the first spreadsheet, and while VisiCalc was the first spreadsheet on the desktop, it’s not actually the first spreadsheet. For example, on its first pass, LANPAR would identify that box 101 needs the values from boxes 201, 301, and 401.
